messages.subject: For Cashel Meagher | Copper growth, community value and stakeholder execution
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Sampieri,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Cashel Meagher, President and Chief Executive Officer.

Capstone Copper is entering an important growth phase across the Americas, with Mantoverde, Santo Domingo and a broader portfolio that links production growth with community value, responsible development and disciplined execution.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate combines government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory across a major mining operation. I work directly across ministries, regulators, communities and operating teams, translating external expectations into clear ownership, evidence, deadlines and executive follow-through.

I would value a conversation about where this operating-side and country-facing experience might support Capstone Copper's stakeholder, social-performance, government-relations or regional leadership priorities, particularly across Latin America and other growth jurisdictions. My attached CV is tailored specifically to Capstone Copper's expansion model.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
